currentOriginal: Years before Earth's destruction, a lone figure entered the Bossvault. It was a small winged creature, none other than the penguin pirate Dreadwing. Without being detected by the ancient security systems, Dreadwing salvaged a large amount of ancient materials. After leaving, Dreadwing used the ancient materials to build a spacecraft more powerful than any in the known universe.
legacyKorean: 지구가 파괴되기 몇 년 전, 한 외로운 인물이 보스볼트에 들어갔어. 그것은 작은 날개 달린 생물, 바로 펭귄 해적 드레드윙이었어. 고대 보안 시스템에 감지되지 않고, 드레드윙은 많은 양의 고대 물질을 구해냈어. 떠난 후, 드레드윙은 고대 물질을 사용하여 알려진 우주에서 가장 강력한 우주선을 만들었어.

currentOriginal: Once he turned it on, however, the machine began scanning the area and acting puzzled as if it had a mind of its own. It seemed the ancient materials and the mysterious core Dreadwing used for the spacecraft's power source had created a "living" machine with its own independent behavior. The spacecraft began firing powerful energy bolts at Dreadwing, but he swiftly dashed through an escape hatch where the machine could not reach him. Having lost sight of its target it left Dreadwing's base and instinctively flew toward the planet
legacyKorean: 그러나 그가 그것을 켰을 때, 기계는 마치 자신의 의지를 가진 것처럼 지역을 스캔하고 혼란스러워하는 것처럼 행동하기 시작했어. 고대 물질과 드레드윙이 우주선의 전원 공급원으로 사용한 신비로운 핵이"살아있는"기계를 만들어 독립적인 행동을 하게 된 것 같았어. 우주선은 드레드윙에게 강력한 에너지 볼트를 발사하기 시작했지만, 그는 기계가 닿을 수 없는 탈출구를 통해 빠르게 빠져나갔어. 목표를 놓친 기계는 드레드윙의 기지를 떠나 본능적으로 행성으로 날아갔어

currentOriginal: where the Bossvault was. As it passed through the galaxy and over planets, people who believed in legends of ancient beings referred to the strange spacecraft traveling over the planet as The Ancient One. Dreadwing, who had learned his lesson about tampering with such power, decided to build his spacecraft out of more conventional materials. As for The Ancient One, it eventually found its way back to the Bossvault and currently guards it against anyone who dares try to steal the ancients' secrets.
legacyKorean: 보스볼트가 있는 곳으로. 은하계를 지나고 행성 위를 지나면서, 고대 존재의 전설을 믿는 사람들은 행성 위를 여행하는 이상한 우주선을 고대의 존재라고 불렀어. 드레드윙은 그러한 힘을 다루는 것에 대한 교훈을 배운 후, 그의 우주선을 더 전통적인 물질로 만들기로 결정했어. 고대의 존재는 결국 보스볼트로 돌아와 고대의 비밀을 훔치려는 사람들을 막고 있어.

currentOriginal: After continuous testing with various lab rats, the Bot of Terror ended up acting VERY suspicious. We attempted fixing our project, but out of nowhere it started shooting a couple bullets at one of the scientists. That's when we realized that we forgot to build a kill switch in case scenarios like this happened.

Unfortunately, we HAD to destroy our creation, but it fought back and caused several casualties. It started shooting out smaller copies of itself. This action was not normal, and we knew we never added that behavior into the code.
legacyKorean: 다양한 실험용 쥐들을 대상으로 한 지속적인 실험 끝에, 테러봇이 매우 수상한 행동을 보이기 시작했습니다. 우리는 프로젝트를 수정하려 했지만, 갑자기 그것이 과학자 중 한 명에게 총알 몇 발을 발사하기 시작했습니다. 그때 우리는 이런 상황에 대비한 킬 스위치를 만들지 않았다는 것을 깨달았습니다.

^#666666;Dark Abyss^reset;
The ^#666666;dark abyss^reset; is a biome that is darker than midnight. The surface seems normal enough, until you dig deep underground, where fog becomes so common that there are literally blocks of it. It is said that you can hear the lost souls of explorers occasionally screaming. Who knows if it's true? The surface is ^red;deathly cold^reset;, and you shouldn't explore the place without the Ancient set. Can be found orbiting ^blue;frozen stars^reset; or ^red;fiery stars^reset;. Portals that lead to abyss dimension are found underground.
